capabilities: Synchronize vault files and settings through a self-hosted Git-backed server
Merge non-overlapping text changes with three-way merges on the server
Resolve overlapping conflicts with an in-app resolver preserving BASE, LOCAL, and REMOTE versions
Transfer only changed file contents using incremental manifests
Configure per-device identity and vault ID for multi-device sync
extras: Early-release warning: keep independent backups and test new devices with a vault copy. Server stores vault contents in plaintext; no end-to-end encryption yet. Can be installed via BRAT (GHloII/reliable-vault-sync) before the in-app index updates.
problem: Obsidian's Sync is a paid service, and standard Git workflows don't handle mobile devices, automatic syncing, or recoverable conflicts inside the app.
summary: Self-hosted Git-backed vault sync plugin that synchronizes notes, attachments, and settings across devices with server-side merging and conflict resolution.
